name: arith_sum_sigma_divisors
statement: (n : ℕ) : ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 d = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, n / d * d.divisors.card
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 d = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, n / d * d.divisors.card
informal: Σ_{d|n} σ(d) = Σ_{d|n} (n/d)τ(d) — both are the Dirichlet convolution id * ζ * ζ evaluated at n (associativity/commutativity of convolution).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) d = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, n / d * d.divisors.card
